labels.reason: Historical reviewer: The rule measures 'complex word density' and fires on sentences where domain-mandatory technical vocabulary (primarily 'implement'/'implementation') repeats within a short span. All 30 samples are RFC specifications, Python PEPs, MDN docs, or technical Q&A where 'implement' is the required standards-language term that cannot be replaced by simpler synonyms. RFC conformance language structurally requires repeating 'MUST implement / SHOULD implement / MAY implement' in the same sentence. The rule has no domain vocabulary allowlist and no distinction between word repetition driven by technical precision vs. stylistic laziness.
